inlines.v: WIFE, noun plural Wives. [G., a woman.] 1. The lawful consort of man; a woman who is united to man in the lawful bonds of wedlock; the correlative of husband. The husband of one wife 1 Timothy 3:2. Let every one of you in particular, so love his wife even as himself, and let the wife see that she reverence her husband. Ephesians 5:23. 2. A woman of low employment; as strawberry wives. [Not in use.]
